title: Joshua De La Victoria agrees with Sungazer Plus

author: Adam Neely
description:
This big band concert film was recorded over the course of two days, July 1-2 2025, at the Blue Note in NYC. Different video of different sets from each night were combined to create this full concert film. 

One day we'll release an album, but until then, please enjoy this set!
